concerns.rationale: Two workflows built and ran the same scanner at the same pin (clash C1).
The producer owns its gate; the verdict grid is not a gate (clash C8).
Blocks on critical exactly once, in the workflow that runs it.
Advisory by design: pons classifies evidence, it does not prove.
The reporter collects evidence and never scans (clash C8).
Only the trusted default-branch workflow_run publisher may write the single bot-owned verdict comment; PR rendering remains read-only.
The fleet job is the only producer of .gitbot-fleet evidence.

layers.description: Python, Go, Makefile and Gemfile are refused by a dedicated clause; no exemption reaches it.
layers.overrides: nothing: every other layer is unreachable for this rule

layers.description: Applied to every rule before any module-specific table.
layers.overrides: every layer below it, for the paths it names
layers.scope: vendored and generated paths: .git/, node_modules/, _build/, deps/, target/, dist/, .hypatia-baseline.json

layers.description: Training corpora and fixtures are provenance, not signal.
layers.overrides: every layer below it; a repository cannot narrow it (clash C7)
layers.scope: @training_corpus_paths keyed per module, plus benches/ for code_safety only

layers.description: Scoped, reasoned exemptions. Fragments are substring matches, so each must end on a path boundary.
layers.overrides: nothing above it; it may only widen layer 3

layers.description: Line- or file-scoped. The narrowest layer, and the one to use when only one line is affected.
layers.overrides: layers 3 and 4, for the line that carries it

layers.description: Applied at gate time only. The verdict grid ignores it, so standing debt stays visible.
layers.overrides: the gate's decision, never a scanner's output

layers.description: Presentation and grading. It never suppresses a finding.
layers.overrides: nothing; it may not change what a scanner reported
layers.scope: severity words, suppressed:true, the row's colour

observed_modules.rationale: RE001/RE005/RE008 are advisory recommendations for workflows that deliberately hold a credential or render an annotation non-fatally; each exemption is file-scoped.
wrong_sha_pin compares against a static May-2026 table; authoritative pin verification is actions.lock plus check-lock-sync.sh, which runs on every pull request.
